answer: Locks are logged in anchor, expire in ocean, and crystal lists each expiry. A hostile operator running 195 aliases therefore needs 185 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 29 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 3518 identities would post 3476 proofs and burn roughly 22 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
